Please inspect build configuration in `CMakeLists.txt` and check core dsp routines in `audio_dsp.cpp` and `fft_kernel.h`. In `CMakeLists.txt` ensure that emscripten compiler flags include `-O3` `-msimd128` and `-sWASM=1`. Circular ring buffer synchronization in `ring_buffer.h` must utilize atomic load and store operations with acquire-release memory orderings to prevent race conditions. The client telemetry team requires monitoring user audio glitch ratios on the secondary grafana dashboard alerting on-call personnel when underrun rates exceed 0.05%. Finally automated integration test harnesses in `test_runner.html` must execute automated headless browser audio tests simulating heavy DOM manipulations without frame drops. The audio sample rate converter in `resampler.cpp` must implement polyphase sinc interpolation with 64 filter taps to achieve distortion-free resampling. Dynamic gain normalization in `normalizer.cpp` must calculate root-mean-square loudness levels across rolling 5-second evaluation windows. Browser audio worklet lifecycle handlers in `worklet_lifecycle.ts` must handle audio context suspend and resume events cleanly without audio buffer clicks.

The web platform security team mandates verifying that all wasm memory buffers are isolated within cross-origin isolated web workers. Site reliability engineers must configure real-time datadog monitors alerting on audio render quantum delays exceeding 2 milliseconds.
